repositories.name: great-scale
repositories.note: README describes mathematical invariants and an additive QGT bridge; physical interpretation is not inferred.

interfaces.contract: Versioned QGT/topological model evidence bound to exact source revisions. Great Scale's residual modules are calculation libraries, not live production measurement endpoints; the G6 producer must bind a fresh same-build observation to model parameters, the signed/absolute curvature tuple, numerical convergence diagnostics, immutable input/output digests, and an independently pinned trust anchor. The proposed receipt schema is contracts/g6-residual-measurement/v1.schema.json (blob a0956c825e9a8974f5855054d2c80eb4433391f9); it maps measurement.STopological to downstream residual.S and measuredAt to residual.measuredAt, but has no live producer/verifier endpoint.
Validated intent and an independently evaluated capability decision.
Resource/method-bound capability and stable operation identity.
Observed execution receipt, status, and lineage.
Receipt provenance and authority state returned to the admission layer.

mapping.buildIdToResidualBuildId: buildId must equal residual.buildId and the G0-G6 attestation buildId; it must be a shared composite release ID binding the Great Scale model run/artifact and Control Plane target build. If independent per-repository build IDs are used, v1 is insufficient and requires a versioned sourceBuildId/acceptanceBuildId contract.
mapping.artifactBinding: artifact.digest identifies the Great Scale model artifact and model.inputDigest binds its inputs; verify both independently and never substitute either for the Control Plane acceptance artifact digest.
mapping.trustBoundary: verify Ed25519 against an independently configured public key; receipt cannot choose its trust anchor
